name: Service debugging — Staging
description: Live debugging: rolling last 15 minutes, refresh every 30 seconds. Requires the HyperDX build with savedRefreshInterval support; older builds ignore this setting. Default: store-api in servers-usc1-stg-cluster / store. Choose cluster, namespace and deployment; leave Pod empty for all deployment pods. Trace ID filters log and span tables only; Log level filters the log table only. Health charts retain workload context. The second trace tab selects errors or durations >= 1s. Resource stats evaluate at the selected range end; CPU rate uses 5m and restarts use a rolling 15m estimate. Missing metrics/limits remain unavailable, not zero. Pod matching assumes standard Deployment-ReplicaSet pod names. Explicit historical URLs stay paused. Trace waterfall/service map open from row details; a log trace ID may have no stored spans. Includes staging API incident response: ingress traffic/errors, application route latency, 15m failure estimates and response-flag triage. API route affects application HTTP panels only; ingress uses <deployment>-service. Grafana endpoint and triage tables are represented as labelled charts. HTTP metrics are derived from staging raw counters/histograms rather than production recording rules. See Scope and first checks for metric windows and filter scope.

filters.name: Trace ID
filters.where: $__filter(cluster_name, $cluster) AND $__filter(namespace_name, $namespace) AND $__filter(deployment_name, $deployment) AND $__filter(pod_name, $pod) AND coalesce(nullIf(json_payload['trace_id'], ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(log, 'trace_id'), ''), '') != ''

config.name: Error logs · selected range
config.where: $__filter(cluster_name, $cluster) AND $__filter(namespace_name, $namespace) AND $__filter(deployment_name, $deployment) AND $__filter(pod_name, $pod) AND lowerUTF8(log_level) IN ('error','fatal','critical')

config.name: Restarts · last 15m
config.promqlExpression: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}"}[15m] @ end())))

config.name: CPU / limits
config.promqlExpression: 100 * (sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m] @ end())))) / (sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",resource="cpu",unit="core"} @ end())) > 0)

config.name: Memory / limits
config.promqlExpression: 100 * (sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"} @ end()))) / (sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",resource="memory",unit="byte"} @ end())) > 0)

config.name: Error logs over time
config.where: $__filter(cluster_name, $cluster) AND $__filter(namespace_name, $namespace) AND $__filter(deployment_name, $deployment) AND $__filter(pod_name, $pod) AND lowerUTF8(log_level) IN ('error','fatal','critical')

config.name: CPU usage and limits
config.promqlExpression: label_replace((sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}[5m])))), "series", "Used", "", "") or label_replace((sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",resource="cpu",unit="core"}))), "series", "Limit", "", "")

config.name: Memory usage and limits
config.promqlExpression: label_replace(((sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",container!="",container!="POD"}))) / 1024 / 1024), "series", "Used", "", "") or label_replace(((sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_limits{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",pod=~"${deployment:regex}-[a-z0-9]+-[a-z0-9]+",pod=~"${pod:regex}",resource="memory",unit="byte"}))) / 1024 / 1024), "series", "Limit", "", "")

config.name: Logs · expand a row for details and trace
config.select: timestamp, deployment_name, pod_name, log_level, log_message, coalesce(nullIf(json_payload['trace_id'], ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(log, 'trace_id'), ''), '') AS trace_id
config.where: $__filter(cluster_name, $cluster) AND $__filter(namespace_name, $namespace) AND $__filter(deployment_name, $deployment) AND $__filter(pod_name, $pod) AND $__filter(log_level, $severity) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(json_payload['trace_id'], ''), nullIf(JSONExtractString(log, 'trace_id'), ''), ''), $trace_id)

config.name: Recent spans · expand to open trace
config.select: Timestamp, ServiceName, SpanName, SpanKind, round(Duration / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, StatusCode, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, TraceId
config.where: $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['cluster']), $cluster) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['namespace']), $namespace) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ''), ServiceName), $deployment) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['pod']), $pod) AND $__filter(TraceId, $trace_id)

config.name: Failed spans or duration ≥ 1s
config.select: Timestamp, ServiceName, SpanName, SpanKind, round(Duration / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, StatusCode, ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'] AS pod, TraceId
config.where: $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.cluster.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['cluster']), $cluster) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.namespace.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['namespace']), $namespace) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.deployment.name'], ''), ServiceName), $deployment) AND $__filter(coalesce(nullIf(ResourceAttributes['k8s.pod.name'], ''), ResourceAttributes['pod']), $pod) AND $__filter(TraceId, $trace_id) AND (lowerUTF8(StatusCode) = 'error' OR Duration >= 1000000000)

config.name: App worst route P95 / P99 · 5m histogram
Scope and first checks
config.markdown:
**Scope:** Cluster / Namespace / Deployment drive incident panels. Deployment maps to the app container and `<deployment>-service` ingress destination. Gateway queries retain unknown backends and use the ingress reporter’s cluster. API route filters application HTTP charts only; Pod, Log level and Trace ID do not narrow incident metrics. Route legends include team / subteam / tier.

**Windows:** Rates and histogram percentiles use rolling 5m; failure counts and worst P99 use rolling 15m, even when the displayed time range changes. Counts are counter-increase estimates, not users. Worst P99 is the maximum route P99 sampled each minute. Reporting endpoints count exported route/ownership combinations; active endpoints require positive request rate. Charts display up to 20 series. Empty telemetry stays unavailable; percentages require positive traffic. Missing 4xx/5xx series become zero only where matching request telemetry exists.

**First checks:** **UH** → healthy endpoints, readiness, available replicas and pending pods. **UF / URX** → connection failures, exhausted retries, saturation and reachability. **UT / UO** → timeouts, overload and latency. **UC** → terminated connections, rollouts, draining, restarts and OOM. Check CPU throttling, readiness and replicas in Infrastructure details. HTTP **0 / DC** is a separate no-response signal and is excluded from 5xx totals.

**Alerting guidance:** alert on aggregate 5xx impact with a traffic floor or SLO burn rate, regardless of flag. Flags guide diagnosis, not incident severity. Replica deficits and latency can warn before 5xx; HPA maximum alone is insufficient. This dashboard does not install alerts.
